sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to two years’ imprisonment followed by three years’ probation.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; leave to appeal sentence granted, sentence appeal dismissed.

sentence_quote: He was sentenced on January 18, 2002 to 12 months imprisonment on the charge of impaired driving causing bodily harm and six months imprisonment on the theft charge, to be served concurrently.
note: Sentences concurrent with each other, consecutive to a one year sentence already being served.

offence_note: Criminal contempt for breaching logging injunction (Fairy Creek)
sentence_quote: the sentencing judge imposed a suspended sentence with 50 hours of community service and 12 months' probation.

offence_note: Aggravated assault by stabbing an intruder
sentence_quote: Mr. Rigler served seven months and one week in prison prior to sentencing. Taking that period into account, the judge imposed an actual sentence of five years and three weeks.
note: Claimed Cree heritage through grandmother; court found link tenuous and no error.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking of heroin, fentanyl, cocaine, methamphetamine, two matters
sentence_quote: Applying the totality principle, the appropriate total sentence is five years' incarceration.
note: Victim surcharge waived; DNA order not made as already on file.

offence_note: Robbery by violent purse-snatching of elderly woman
sentence_quote: Florence Jimmie applies for leave to appeal her sentence of two years plus a day for the July 9, 2008 robbery of an 81-year-old woman at Quesnel, B.C.
systemic_quote: She identified the mitigating factors as Ms. Jimmie's early guilty plea, her acceptance of responsibility for her actions, her 35 days pre-sentence custody and the factors in Gladue.
note: Leave granted, appeal dismissed; credit is 35 days pre-sentence custody.

offence_note: Break and enter, robbery with knife, assault with weapon, mischief
